description: This file defines a configuration class for a plugin within the WPEFramework project. It includes nested classes for handling JSON-based configuration data, including root configuration options, mode types, and various plugin settings. It also declares a Setting class for logging configuration changes.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin, containing nested classes for root configuration and mode types, as well as plugin settings.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Represents the root configuration options, including mode, locator, user, and other settings, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: Config::RootObject
classes.description: Internal class used for JSON parsing of configuration string, holding a single Config string.

classes.name: Config::Setting
classes.description: Utility class for logging configuration changes, preventing copying and assignment.

methods.name: Config::DataPath
methods.description: Constructs a data path string based on the base path and class name.

methods.name: Config::PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs a persistent storage path based on the base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs a volatile storage path based on the base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same plugin instance based on locator and class name.

methods.name: Config::Setting::Setting
methods.description: Constructor for boolean and string settings, logs the change.
